subject: general
question:
What is the median of the following data?

74, 85, 67, 27, 47, 16, 41, 32, 98, 38, 88
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Count the total number of observations, **n = 11** (which is an **odd number**).

Arrange the data in **ascending order**: 16, 27, 32, 38, 41, 47, 67, 74, 85, 88, 98.

For odd **n**, the **Median** is the middle term: ((n + 1) ÷ 2)th term.

Median = (12 ÷ 2)th term = **6th term** = 47.

**∴ The correct answer is 47.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Data set = {74, 85, 67, 27, 47, 16, 41, 32, 98, 38, 88}

**Formula Used:** Median = ((n + 1) ÷ 2)th term, where **n** is the number of observations (when **n** is odd).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/523342897941bf4c76a647e00f61b2e4835a6a007ce97c4487e8f64fb76af15e.png] 

⇒ Total number of observations (n) = 11

⇒ Arranging the data in **ascending order**: 16, 27, 32, 38, 41, 47, 67, 74, 85, 88, 98

⇒ Median = ((11 + 1) ÷ 2)th term

⇒ Median = 6th term

⇒ Median = 47

**∴ The correct answer is 47.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Median for Even Number of Terms

If **n** is even, the **Median** is the arithmetic mean of the (n/2)th and (n/2 + 1)th terms after arranging the data in order.

Mean (Arithmetic Average)

The **Mean** is the sum of all observations divided by the total number of observations: Σx ÷ n.

Mode

The **Mode** is the value that occurs most frequently in the given data set. A data set can have one mode, more than one mode, or no mode at all.</p
